messages.subject: Re: Mentors: please add to GSOC-R'23 wiki!
messages.subject_clean: Mentors: please add to GSOC-R'23 wiki!
messages.body_plain:
Dear all, R has been accepted as a mentoring org for GSOC'23!
Currently there are 11 project ideas listed on the wiki. One of the project ideas I posted has already got a potential contributor that did the tests!
Mentors, pease add project ideas ASAP so you can maximize chances of finding a quality contributor.
Thanks
Toby

On Thursday, January 26, 2023 at 10:39:40 AM UTC-7 tdh...@gmail.com wrote:
> Dear mentors, I have submitted the application for R project in Google Summer of Code 2023.
> The ideas list this year is https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2023/wiki/table%20of%20proposed%20coding%20projects so please add your project ideas ASAP so you can find a contributor.
> Thanks!
> Toby
